BluePearl Pet Hospital – serving Spring and the Greater Houston area.
We are located just off I45 in Spring, Texas, and we serve pets and their families in the greater Houston area, including Atascocita, Cleveland, Conroe, Crosby, Cypress, Dayton, Hempstead, Hockley, Humble, Jersey Village, Liberty, Magnolia, Mont Belvieu, Montgomery, New Caney, Pinehurst, Plantersville, The Woodlands, Todd Mission and Waller.
Our reviews.
Our services.
When you have a pet emergency, seconds count. We want you to know, we’re ready 24/7. If your pet has a condition that requires a specialist’s expertise, we’re ready for that too. Our experienced veterinarians, vet technicians and support staff work closely together to provide the comprehensive, compassionate care your pet needs and deserves.
Emergency
In an emergency, call ahead to your BluePearl vet and let us know you’re coming. No appointment is necessary for our emergency vet.
Learn more about your emergency visit
.
Specialty care
Our veterinary specialists work directly with your primary care vet to understand your pet’s condition and develop the appropriate treatment plan. Visits to our specialists are usually by referral from your primary care vet and by appointment.

About BluePearl Pet Hospital Spring.
When Hurricane Harvey dropped more than 50 inches of rain on Houston in 2017, our local BluePearl emergency pet hospitals stayed open, ready to treat your sick or injured pets. That same devotion drives our staff any time a patient comes through the door.
Our BluePearl Spring hospital offers 24-hour emergency vet care teamed with board-certified specialists and state-of-the-art equipment.
Formerly known as North Houston Veterinary Specialists, our Spring hospital is easily accessible from State Highway 99 and Interstate 45.
Pet owners.
At BluePearl Pet Hospitals, providing our customers with remarkable service is a top priority. We’re committed to making your veterinary visit as smooth as possible.

Testimonials.
“Dr. Jennifer Cordova is an expert in the care of greyhounds, which is a very special breed. When my greyhound, Miss Franny, suffered an injury to her right hock recently, I knew she needed special care and that Dr. Cordova was the one to provide that emergency care. I called BluePearl in Spring, Texas, and luckily Dr. C was working there.
Dr. C wasted no time after we arrived, and she provided exactly the sort of expert and compassionate care I expected. Ditto for her vet tech, Amber. I am truly blessed to know Dr. Cordova and to have the sort of expert care BluePearl provides to pet parents in Houston. We received immediate triage and care, proper discharge instructions, and Dr. C followed up with my primary providers regarding results and aftercare. Please send our kind thanks to Dr. C. Her passion for emergency pet medicine is evident, and she always delivers world-class care and support to pets and their pet parents. We love you Dr. C!”
–Eric R.
